long_biography.plain_text:
Samathur Li Kin-kan is a Hong Kong real estate investor from the family behind Prudential Enterprise, the property company led for decades by his father, Samuel Tak Lee. A Hong Kong High Court judgment records that Li became a director in 1995 and that the company was managed by Lee and his children. Li also developed a multibillion-dollar Japanese property business using seed capital from his father, who retained a nominal buyback right. That structure makes family transfer, rather than documented inheritance, the clearest origin of Li’s established wealth.

Li has also made private investments outside property, although public reporting continues to identify him primarily as a real estate investor. In 2015 he signed documents connected with his father’s $118 million gift to create an MIT real estate entrepreneurship lab focused on responsible and sustainable development. Public records also identify him as British as well as Chinese.

Marriage / family transfer is used because the clearest documented mechanism is seed capital supplied by Li's father during his lifetime, with a retained nominal buyback right. Samuel Tak Lee died in May 2026, but reporting says estate administration remains in progress and does not establish that Samathur has inherited the principal estate assets.

Operator is based on Li's documented 1995 appointment as a Prudential Enterprise director, the court's finding that the company was managed by Samuel Tak Lee and his children, and Li's development of the Japanese property business. No reliable current source located in this review defines his present day-to-day leadership duties.

No authoritative source established a more precise place of birth than the existing Hong Kong birth-country entry, and no reliable evidence supplied a middle name. Those blank researchable fields remain unfilled.

Cayman Compass directly attributes Pelorus to Li and reports his ownership company, so the long biography includes that yacht.
